question: **How long was the narrator going to stay at his cousin’s place?**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Two days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• It is said in the second sentence of the first paragraph of the given passage that *"*As they approached us, one of them said to me, *“It was Saturday and I was staying for the weekend at my cousin’s place." *
 
• **Weekend **means **Saturday and Sunday**.
 
• From here we can say that **The narrator will spend two days at his cousin's house.**

Hence the correct answer is option 4.
